summary: Rings now work the same way everywhere, from dev to test to broad.

new.title: One ring order everywhere
new.text: Replication rings now run like update rings: 0 is dev, 1 is test, 2 is broad. Existing rings are converted once, so everyone keeps reaching exactly what they reached.

new.title: Tags live on the deployment ring
new.text: The Managed tenant registry page has a Deployment rings card where you name each ring and narrow it with a tag rule. Existing admin tags are kept and shown.

fixes.title: Older managed tenants keep working
fixes.text: A managed tenant on an older version converts the old ring numbers itself.
